articles.title: The future of Ai in India: A Nobel Laureate’s perspective
articles.summary: The Surfin Ai Fintech Summit's seventh global edition showcased advancements in intelligent finance and AI-driven customer solutions. Esteemed speakers, including Nobel Laureate Michael Spence and Dr. Amar Patnaik, underscored the concept of principles preceding laws in AI governance. Discussions revolved around AI's role in improving financial accessibility and personalized services for varied clientele.
